state.goal: Where are scraped items written out to JSON, CSV or XML?

in_scrapy_extensions.instructions: Which entry is most likely to contain the code that the goal is about?

criteria.c1: closespider.py: CloseSpider is an extension that forces spiders to be closed after certain conditions are met. Defines CloseSpider.
criteria.c2: corestats.py: Extension for collecting core stats like items scraped and start/finish times. Defines CoreStats.
criteria.c3: debug.py: Extensions for debugging Scrapy. Defines StackTraceDump, Debugger.
criteria.c4: feedexport.py: Feed Exports extension. Defines apply_uri_params, ItemFilter, FeedStorageProtocol, BlockingFeedStorage, StdoutFeedStorage, FileFeedStorage, S3FeedStorage, GCSFeedStorage and more.
criteria.c5: httpcache.py: Defines DummyPolicy, RFC2616Policy, DbmCacheStorage, FilesystemCacheStorage, parse_cachecontrol, rfc1123_to_epoch.
criteria.c11: postprocessing.py: Extension for processing data before they are exported to feeds. Defines GzipPlugin, Bz2Plugin, LZMAPlugin, PostProcessingManager.
criteria.c14: statsmailer.py: StatsMailer extension sends an email when a spider finishes scraping. Defines StatsMailer.
criteria.c15: telnet.py: Scrapy Telnet Console extension. Defines TelnetConsole, _get_manhole_class.
criteria.none: None of the listed entries is related to the goal.
